probes.check: After Jolt shuts down, the facade's probe-build block tracking shows Jolt released no block the facade didn't allocate; one it did fails the rule as ALLOC_HOOK_LATE(jolt).

seeded_violation.description: Register Jolt's default allocator and allocate a block before installing the hooks, then free it through them.

probes.check: am_probe_jolt_allocation(): JPH::Allocate, Reallocate, Free, AlignedAllocate and AlignedFree are the five jolt trampolines, and the facade served Jolt during the run.

seeded_violation.description: Install Jolt's default allocator with JPH::RegisterDefaultAllocator() in place of the hooks.

adaptation_notes: Jolt's allocation functions are global function pointers, null until set: install them before JPH::Factory and JPH::RegisterTypes(), and don't call JPH::RegisterDefaultAllocator().
The hooks are unavailable when Jolt is built with JPH_DISABLE_CUSTOM_ALLOCATOR; the joltphysics port builds with them.
Jolt passes the old size to Reallocate; the facade doesn't need it.
